description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature or object within 120 ft. A hit deals 1d10 fire damage. A flammable object it hits catches fire if nobody is wearing or carrying it.
Damage rises to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 11 and 4d10 at level 17.
Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 60 ft. A hit deals 1d8 cold damage and cuts the target's speed by 10 ft until your next turn begins.
Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.
Touch a willing creature. Once before the spell ends, it can roll a d4 and add the result to one ability check of its choice, rolling either before or after the d20. The spell then ends.
A flame sits in your palm for 10 minutes, harmless to you and your gear, lighting a 10 ft radius brightly and a further 10 ft dimly. Dismiss it as an action, or recast, to end it.
When you cast it, or as an action later, you can throw it at a creature within 30 ft (ranged spell attack; 1d8 fire on a hit). Throwing it ends the spell.
Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.

A club or quarterstaff you hold turns magical for 1 minute. Your melee attacks with it, for hit and damage, rely on your spellcasting ability rather than Strength, and it deals a d8. Recasting the spell or dropping the weapon ends it.
shillelagh.material: mistletoe, shamrock leaf, a club or quarterstaff

description: You fire 3 darts of force at creatures you choose within 120 ft that you can see. Each dart strikes automatically for 1d4+1 force damage. You can send every dart at one target or split them across several.
magic-missile.higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 dart.

description: Until your next turn begins, you gain +5 AC, which also applies to the attack that triggered the spell. For the same time you take no harm from magic missile.

Flames fan out from your hands in a 15 ft cone. Each creature in the cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success. Flammable objects in the cone that nobody is wearing or carrying catch fire.
burning-hands.higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

description: A creature you touch regains 1d8 hit points plus your spellcasting modifier. Undead and constructs are not healed.
cure-wounds.higherLevels: Healing rises by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

description: A wave of force bursts out from you in a 15 ft cube. Creatures inside roll a Constitution save: failing means 2d8 thunder damage and a 10 ft shove away from you; passing means half damage and no shove.
Loose objects in the cube are pushed 10 ft too, and the boom can be heard 300 ft away.
thunderwave.higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

description: Touch a willing creature that wears no armor. For 8 hours its base AC becomes 13 plus its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends early if the target dons armor or you dismiss it as an action.
In a puff of silver mist you teleport up to 30 ft to an empty space you can see. It costs only a bonus action and needs just a spoken word, no gestures.
A streak flies to a point you pick within 150 ft and blooms into a 20 ft radius burst of flame. Each creature there makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
The blast wraps around corners and sets alight any flammable objects in the area that nobody is wearing or carrying.
fireball.higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 3.
fireball.material: Pellet of bat guano and sulfur

description: Pick a humanoid you can see within 60 ft. It makes a Wisdom save or is paralyzed. It repeats the save when each of its own turns finishes; a success frees it and ends the spell on it.
hold-person.higherLevels: A higher slot holds 1 extra humanoid per level above 2; targets must stand within 30 ft of one another.

description: You hurl a bubble of acid at 1 creature within 60 ft, or at 2 creatures within 5 ft of each other. Each target makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 acid damage.
Damage rises to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11 and 4d6 at level 17.
Until the end of your next turn, weapon attacks deal you only half their bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage (you have resistance to those types).

A ghostly hand grips a creature within 120 ft: make a ranged spell attack. A hit deals 1d8 necrotic damage, and the target cannot heal until your next turn starts. An undead target you hit also attacks you at disadvantage through the end of your next turn.
Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.
Up to 4 torch-like lights hover at points within 120 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration), or you can fuse them into one glowing humanoid form. Each gives dim light in a 10 ft radius.
Use a bonus action to shift any of them up to 60 ft. Keep them within 20 ft of one another; any that ends up over 120 ft from you vanishes.
dancing-lights.material: a bit of phosphorus, wychwood or a glowworm

description: Choose one minor nature trick within 30 ft:
• A tiny, harmless sign (a golden orb for sun, a cloud for rain, snowflakes) forecasts your local weather for the next 24 hours; it lasts 1 round.
• Instantly bloom a flower, burst open a seed pod or unfurl a leaf bud.
• Produce an instant, harmless sensory effect that fits in a 5 ft cube: drifting leaves, a breeze, a small animal noise, a faint smell.
• Ignite or put out a candle, torch or small campfire.
Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 120 ft. A hit deals 1d10 force damage.
At level 5 you fire 2 beams, at level 11 3 beams and at level 17 4 beams. Each beam needs its own attack roll and may go at the same or different targets.
For up to 1 minute (concentration) you have advantage on Charisma checks aimed at one creature of your choice that is not hostile to you.
When the spell ends, that creature realizes you used magic on it and turns hostile toward you. A violent one may attack you; others may seek revenge in other ways, at the DM's discretion.
friends.material: a little makeup applied to your face as you cast

description: One object up to 10 ft across glows for 1 hour: bright light 20 ft out, dim light another 20 ft, in any colour you pick. Something opaque placed over it hides the glow. Casting the spell again, or dismissing it as an action, ends it.
If a hostile creature is holding or wearing the object, it can make a Dexterity save to avoid the spell.
A floating hand appears at a point within 30 ft and stays for 1 minute. It vanishes if you dismiss it as an action, cast the spell again, or it is ever more than 30 ft from you.

Use your action to control it, moving it up to 30 ft each time: handle an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or fetch an item from an open container, or pour out a vial. It cannot attack, activate magic items, or carry over 10 lb.
Touch a single break or rip no longer than 1 ft in any direction, such as a snapped chain link, torn cloak or leaking wineskin. It mends with no trace of damage.
It can physically fix a magic item or construct, but cannot bring back any magic the object lost.
Point at a creature within 120 ft and whisper. Only it hears you, and it can whisper an answer only you hear.

It works through solid objects if you know the target is behind the barrier and are familiar with it. Magical silence, 1 ft of stone, 1 inch of metal, thin lead or 3 ft of wood blocks it. It bends around corners and through openings.
message.material: a short piece of copper wire

description: Within 30 ft you make either a sound or the image of an object, lasting 1 minute. A sound can be a whisper to a scream, steady or in bursts. An image fits in a 5 ft cube and makes no sound, smell or light. Dismiss it as an action, or recast to end it.
A creature that spends an action examining it makes an Investigation check against your spell save DC to see through it, and it then looks faint to them. Touching it also exposes it.
You puff noxious gas at a creature you can see within 10 ft. It makes a Constitution save or takes 1d12 poison damage.
Damage rises to 2d12 at level 5, 3d12 at level 11 and 4d12 at level 17.
Pick one minor trick within 10 ft:
• Harmless sensory effect: sparks, a gust, soft notes, an odd smell.
• Light or snuff a candle, torch or small campfire.
• Clean or soil an object up to 1 cubic ft.
• Chill, warm or flavour 1 cubic ft of non-living material for 1 hour.
• A colour, mark or symbol on a surface for 1 hour.
• A hand-sized trinket or illusory image until your next turn ends.
Up to 3 timed effects at once; dismiss one as an action.
You touch a willing creature. Once before the spell ends, it can roll a d4 and add it to one saving throw of its choice, before or after rolling the save. The spell then ends.
Radiance falls on a creature you can see within 60 ft. It makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d8 radiant damage. Cover gives it no bonus to this save.
Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.
Make a melee spell attack against a creature you touch, with advantage if it wears metal armor. A hit deals 1d8 lightning damage, and the target cannot take reactions until its next turn begins.
Damage rises to 2d8 at level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.
Touch a living creature at 0 hit points. It becomes stable. Undead and constructs are unaffected.
You show a minor wonder within 30 ft. Choose one:
• Your voice booms up to 3 times louder for 1 minute.
• Flames flicker, brighten, dim or change colour for 1 minute.
• Harmless tremors shake the ground for 1 minute.
• A sound you choose starts at a point you pick.
• An unlocked door or window flies open or slams shut.
• Your eyes change appearance for 1 minute.
Up to 3 of the 1-minute effects at once; dismiss one as an action.
Make a melee spell attack against a creature within 30 ft. A hit deals 1d6 piercing damage, and if the target is Large or smaller you can yank it up to 10 ft closer to you.
Damage rises to 2d6 at level 5, 3d6 at level 11 and 4d6 at level 17.
thorn-whip.material: the stem of a plant with thorns

description: Point at a target within 30 ft. On your next turn, your first attack roll against it has advantage, provided the spell is still going (concentration, 1 round).

You hurl a cutting insult at a creature you can see within 60 ft. If it can hear you (it need not understand), it makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d4 psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
Damage rises to 2d4 at level 5, 3d4 at level 11 and 4d4 at level 17.
Ward a door, window or area up to a 20 ft cube within 30 ft for 8 hours. Whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters it, you are alerted. You can name creatures that do not set it off.
Choose the alert type when casting. Mental: a ping in your mind, which wakes you, if you are within 1 mile. Audible: a hand-bell sound for 10 seconds, heard within 60 ft. Ritual.
Pick a beast you can see within 30 ft; it must be able to see and hear you. If its Intelligence is 4 or higher, the spell fails. Otherwise it makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for 24 hours.
The charm ends if you or your companions harm it.
animal-friendship.higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 lets you affect 1 more beast.

description: You gain 5 temporary hit points for 1 hour, wrapped in spectral frost. While any remain, a creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 cold damage.
armor-of-agathys.higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 5 temporary hit points and 5 cold damage.

description: Dark tentacles erupt from you in a 10 ft radius. Each creature in the area makes a Strength save, taking 2d6 necrotic damage on a failure or half on a success.
A creature that fails also cannot take reactions until its next turn.
arms-of-hadar.higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

description: Up to 3 creatures you can see within 30 ft each make a Charisma save. For the duration (concentration, 1 minute), each one that fails rolls a d4 whenever it makes an attack roll or saving throw, and lowers that result by the number rolled.
bane.higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target.

description: Up to 3 creatures within 30 ft are blessed for 1 minute (concentration). Whenever a target attacks or saves, it can roll a d4 and add it to the result.
bless.higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target.

description: Pick a humanoid you can see within 30 ft. It makes a Wisdom save, with advantage if you or your allies are fighting it. Failing, it is charmed for 1 hour, and sees you as a friendly acquaintance. Harming it ends the charm.
It knows afterwards that you magically influenced it.
charm-person.higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target; they must be within 30 ft of each other.

description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature you can see within 90 ft. Pick the orb's type first: acid, cold, fire, lightning, poison or thunder. A hit deals 3d8 damage of that type.
chromatic-orb.higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

description: Roll 6d10 for a pool of hit points. Creatures in a 15 ft cone are affected in order of lowest current hit points first, skipping unconscious creatures and those that cannot see.
Each creature whose hit points fit within what is left of the pool is blinded until the spell ends (1 round), and its hit points are subtracted from the pool.
color-spray.higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 2d10 to the roll.
color-spray.material: a pinch of powder or sand coloured red, yellow and blue

description: Give a one-word order to a creature within 60 ft that you can see. It makes a Wisdom save or carries out the command on its next turn. Nothing happens if it is undead, does not understand your language, or the command would directly harm it.

Sample words: Approach (comes toward you, stopping within 5 ft), Drop (lets go of what it holds), Flee (moves away fast), Grovel (falls prone), Halt (no move, no actions). The DM rules on other words; if the target cannot obey, the spell ends.
command.higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target; they must be within 30 ft of each other.

description: A creature you can see within 30 ft makes a Wisdom save. If it fails, for 1 minute (concentration) it has disadvantage on attacks against anyone but you. To move more than 30 ft from you it needs a Wisdom save; success lifts the limit that turn.

The spell ends if you attack another creature or cast a spell at a hostile creature besides the target, if an ally damages the target or aims a harmful spell at it, or if you finish a turn over 30 ft away.
For 1 hour, you understand any spoken language you hear. If you touch a surface bearing writing, you can read it too, taking about 1 minute per page.
It does not reveal hidden meaning, secret codes or non-written symbols. Ritual.
comprehend-languages.material: a pinch of soot and salt

description: Pick one effect, aimed within 30 ft:
• Create: fills an open container with up to 10 gallons of fresh water, or rain soaks a 30 ft cube and douses flames there.
• Destroy: removes up to 10 gallons of water from an open container, or burns off fog in a 30 ft cube.
create-or-destroy-water.higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 10 gallons, or 5 ft to the cube's side.
create-or-destroy-water.material: a drop of water for creating, or a few grains of sand for destroying

description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration) you sense whether aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends or undead are within 30 ft, and where. You also sense places or objects within 30 ft that are consecrated or desecrated.
1 ft of stone, 1 inch of metal, thin lead or 3 ft of wood or dirt blocks it.
For up to 10 minutes (concentration) you sense magic within 30 ft. As an action you can see a faint aura around any visible magical creature or object there, and learn its school of magic.
1 ft of stone, 1 inch of metal, thin lead or 3 ft of wood or dirt blocks it. Ritual.
For up to 10 minutes (concentration) you sense poisons, poisonous creatures and diseases within 30 ft, learning what kind each one is and where.
1 ft of stone, 1 inch of metal, thin lead or 3 ft of wood or dirt blocks it. Ritual.
For 1 hour, or until you dismiss it as an action, you and your gear look different. You can seem 1 ft taller or shorter, thin, fat or in between, but must keep the same basic limb arrangement.
It fails touch inspection: a fake hat would let hands pass through. A creature can use an action to inspect you and make an Investigation check against your spell save DC to see through it.
You whisper a jarring tune that only one creature you choose within 60 ft can hear. It makes a Wisdom save, taking 3d6 psychic damage on a failure or half on a success.

On a failure it must also spend its reaction, if it has one, to move as far from you as its speed allows, steering clear of obvious hazards like fire or a pit. Deafened creatures pass the save automatically.
dissonant-whispers.higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

description: For 1 minute (concentration), each time you hit with a weapon attack you add 1d4 radiant damage.
Your next weapon hit within 1 minute (concentration) also conjures thorny vines around the target. It makes a Strength save (advantage if Large or bigger) or is restrained.

Each of its turns begins with 1d6 piercing damage while the vines hold. The target, or anyone able to touch it, can use an action and beat your spell save DC with a Strength check to free it, ending the vines.
ensnaring-strike.higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

description: Thick weeds and vines sprout across a 20 ft square within 90 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration), making it difficult terrain. Anyone inside when you cast it makes a Strength save or is restrained.
To break free, a restrained creature spends an action and beats your spell save DC with a Strength check. The growth fades when the spell ends.
For up to 10 minutes (concentration), you may Dash as a bonus action on every turn, starting with the turn you cast this.

Pick a 20 ft cube within 60 ft. Objects in it glow blue, green or violet (your choice); each creature in it makes a Dexterity save and, on a failure, glows too. This lasts up to 1 minute (concentration).
Glowing things shed dim light for 10 ft. Attacks against them have advantage if the attacker can see them, and invisibility does not hide them.
You gain 1d4+4 temporary hit points for 1 hour.
false-life.higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 5 temporary hit points.
false-life.material: a little alcohol or distilled spirits

description: Reaction when you or a creature within 60 ft falls. Up to 5 falling creatures within range drop at only 60 ft per round for 1 minute. One that lands before then takes no falling damage and lands on its feet, and the spell ends for it.
feather-fall.material: a small feather or piece of down

description: Forms: bat, cat, crab, frog, hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, fish, rat, raven, sea horse, spider or weasel. A celestial, fey or fiend, it obeys you, has its own initiative, never attacks.
Within 100 ft: telepathy; it delivers your touch spells by reaction. As an action, borrow its senses until your next turn; you are blind and deaf meanwhile.
At 0 hit points it vanishes until recast. An action dismisses it to a pocket dimension (recall within 30 ft) or forever. Recast to change its form; only 1 familiar.
find-familiar.material: 10 gp of charcoal, incense and herbs, burned

description: You raise a 20 ft radius sphere of fog centred on a point within 120 ft, for up to 1 hour (concentration). It spreads around corners and heavily obscures the area. A wind of 10 mph or more disperses it early.
fog-cloud.higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 20 ft to the radius.

description: Up to 10 berries appear in your hand, magical for 24 hours. A creature can use its action to eat one: it restores 1 hit point and feeds the creature for a day.
Berries not eaten within 24 hours lose their magic.
Slick grease covers a 10 ft square on the ground within 60 ft for 1 minute, making it difficult terrain. Anyone standing in it when you cast it makes a Dexterity save or falls prone.
A creature that enters or ends its turn there makes the same save.
grease.material: a bit of pork rind or butter

description: Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 120 ft. A hit deals 4d6 radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of your next turn has advantage, thanks to the glow.
guiding-bolt.higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

description: Your next ranged weapon hit before the spell ends (concentration, up to 1 minute) makes thorns burst from your weapon or ammunition. Besides the attack's normal effect, the target and every creature within 5 ft of it make a Dexterity save, taking 1d10 piercing damage on a failure or half on a success.
hail-of-thorns.higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d10 for each slot level above 1, to a maximum of 6d10.

description: A creature you can see within 60 ft regains 1d4 hit points plus your spellcasting modifier. Undead and constructs are not healed.
healing-word.higherLevels: Healing rises by 1d4 for each slot level above 1.

description: Reaction when a creature you can see within 60 ft damages you. Flames wreath it, and it makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d10 fire damage on a failure or half on a success.
hellish-rebuke.higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d10 for each slot level above 1.

description: A willing creature you touch gains courage for 1 minute (concentration). It cannot be frightened, and each of its turns begins with temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting modifier.
When the spell ends, it loses any temporary hit points this spell gave it.
heroism.higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target.

description: Curse one creature within 90 ft you can see for up to 1 hour (concentration). Each time you hit it with an attack you deal an extra 1d6 necrotic damage, and it has disadvantage on checks with one ability score you choose when you cast the spell.
If it drops to 0 hit points, you can move the curse to a new creature within range as a bonus action on a later turn. Remove curse on the target ends the spell early.
hex.higherLevels: A level 3 or 4 slot lets concentration last up to 8 hours; level 5 or higher, up to 24 hours.
hex.material: the petrified eye of a newt

description: Mark a creature you can see within 90 ft as your quarry for up to 1 hour (concentration). Each hit you land on it with a weapon deals 1d6 extra damage, and you have advantage on Perception and Survival checks to find it.
If it drops to 0 hit points first, you can spend a bonus action on a later turn to move the mark to a new creature.
hunters-mark.higherLevels: A level 3 or 4 slot lets concentration last up to 8 hours; level 5 or higher, up to 24 hours.

description: Over 1 minute, touch an object throughout the casting. A magic item reveals what it does and how to use it, whether it needs attunement, and its charges. You also learn which spells, if any, are affecting it, what they are, and which spell made it, if one did.
Touch a creature instead to learn which spells currently affect it. Ritual.
identify.material: a pearl worth 100 gp and an owl feather

description: Over 1 minute you write on parchment, paper or similar material, laying an illusion on it that lasts 10 days. You and anyone you name see it as normal writing with the meaning you intended. Everyone else sees an unreadable, unknown script.
Alternatively, others can see a wholly different message, in another hand and a language you know.
Dispelling it destroys both the script and the illusion. A creature with truesight can read the hidden message. Ritual.
You strike a creature you touch with a melee spell attack. If it hits, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage.
inflict-wounds.higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d10 for each slot level above 1.

description: You touch a creature. For 1 minute its jump distance is 3 times normal.
A creature you touch gains +10 ft of speed for 1 hour.
longstrider.higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 1 target.

description: A willing creature you touch gains a ward for up to 10 minutes (concentration) against aberrations, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends and undead. Those creatures attack it at disadvantage and cannot possess it or charm or frighten it.
If one of them already has it charmed, frightened or possessed, it has advantage on any new save against that effect.
protection-from-evil-and-good.material: holy water, or powdered silver and iron (used up)

description: All non-magical food and drink in a 5 ft radius sphere centred on a point within 10 ft is cleansed of poison and disease. Ritual.
Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 60 ft. A hit deals 2d8 poison damage, and the target makes a Constitution save or is poisoned until the end of your next turn.
ray-of-sickness.higherLevels: Damage rises by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.

description: Bonus action. Ward a creature within 30 ft for 1 minute. Anyone who targets it with an attack or harmful spell must first make a Wisdom save, or pick a new target or lose the attack or spell.
Area effects such as a fireball are not stopped. The ward ends if the warded creature attacks, or targets or catches a foe with a spell.
Your next melee weapon hit before the spell ends (concentration, up to 1 minute) deals an extra 1d6 fire damage and sets the target alight.

Each time one of its turns starts while it burns, the target makes a Constitution save. A failure deals it 1d6 fire damage; a success ends the spell with no damage. The fire also goes out, ending the spell, if the target or someone within 5 ft spends an action to smother it, or if something douses it, such as plunging under water.
searing-smite.higherLevels: The extra damage on the hit rises by 1d6 for each slot level above 1.

description: A creature within 60 ft is surrounded by a shimmering field and gains +2 AC for up to 10 minutes (concentration).
shield-of-faith.material: a small parchment with holy text written on it

description: You create an image of an object, creature or effect within 60 ft, no larger than a 15 ft cube. It makes no sound, smell or other sensation, and lasts up to 10 minutes (concentration).

As an action you can move it anywhere in range, and its look can change to match. A creature that spends its action studying it can make an Investigation check against your spell save DC to see through it. Touching it reveals it.

Roll 5d8 to get a pool of hit points. Choose a point within 90 ft: creatures within 20 ft of it drop off in order of lowest current hit points, skipping those already unconscious. Each one's hit points are deducted from the pool, and a creature with more than what remains is unaffected.
Sleepers stay unconscious for 1 minute, or until they are hurt or someone spends an action shaking or slapping them. Undead and anything immune to charm are skipped.
sleep.higherLevels: Each slot level above 1 adds 2d8 to the roll.
sleep.material: fine sand, rose petals or a cricket

description: For 10 minutes you can understand and talk with beasts. Their knowledge is limited, but they can tell you about nearby places and monsters, and may do a small favour at the DM's discretion. Ritual.

A creature you can see within 30 ft, with Intelligence 5 or more, makes a Wisdom save. On a failure it collapses in fits of laughter, prone and incapacitated and unable to stand, for up to 1 minute (concentration).
Each time its turn ends it repeats the save, and it also repeats it (with advantage) whenever it is hurt. Passing ends the spell.
A horizontal disk of force, 3 ft across and 1 inch thick, floats 3 ft above the ground in a free space within 30 ft for 1 hour. It holds up to 500 lb; more weight ends the spell and everything drops.
It stays put while you are within 20 ft, and trails you to stay within 20 ft if you move away. It cannot cross a 10 ft height change. If you get more than 100 ft from it, the spell ends. Ritual.

Your next melee weapon hit within 1 minute (concentration) rings with a thunderclap audible 300 ft away and deals 2d6 extra thunder damage. The target makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 ft away and knocked prone.
An invisible, mindless, shapeless force appears on the ground within 60 ft for 1 hour. Its AC is 10, it has 1 hit point and Strength 2, and it cannot attack. Reaching 0 hit points ends the spell.

Once per turn, as a bonus action, send it up to 15 ft to interact with an object. It does simple chores (fetching, cleaning, mending, folding, lighting fires, serving food, pouring wine), working a task until done. A task taking it over 60 ft from you ends the spell. Ritual.
Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 30 ft. A hit deals 1d12 lightning damage and links you to the target with a beam for up to 1 minute (concentration).

On each later turn you can use your action to zap it for 1d12 lightning damage with no roll. The link breaks if you use your action on anything else, or if the target ends up out of range or behind full cover.
witch-bolt.higherLevels: The first hit's damage rises by 1d12 for each slot level above 1.

description: Your next melee weapon hit within 1 minute (concentration) adds 1d6 psychic damage. The target also makes a Wisdom save or becomes frightened of you for the rest of the spell.
Once frightened, it can spend an action on a Wisdom check, trying to beat your spell save DC. Success ends the spell.
Pick up to 3 creatures within 30 ft. For 8 hours, each one gains 5 hit points to its hit point maximum and 5 to its current hit points.
aid.higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds another 5 hit points per target.

description: You reshape yourself for up to 1 hour (concentration). Pick one option; as an action you can swap it for another.
Aquatic Adaptation: gills and webbed fingers. You breathe water and swim at your walking speed.
Change Appearance: choose your height, weight, face, voice, hair, even another race. Stats, size and body shape stay. Reshape again as an action.
Natural Weapons: claws, fangs or horns. Unarmed strikes deal 1d6 bludgeoning, piercing or slashing, count as magic, are proficient and get +1 to attack and damage.
Pick a Tiny beast you can see within 30 ft. Name a place you have visited, describe a recipient, and give it a message of up to 25 words.

For the duration it travels there, about 50 miles per 24 hours if it flies or 25 miles if not, then repeats the message in your voice, only to someone matching your description. If it doesn't arrive in time, the message is lost and the beast heads back to you.
animal-messenger.higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 48 hours to the duration.

description: You raise a pile of bones (skeleton) or a Small or Medium humanoid corpse (zombie) within 10 ft as your undead servant. The DM has its stats.

Bonus action on your turn: give any of your undead within 60 ft one shared order, either a move and action for its next turn or a standing task like guarding a hall. Unordered, it only defends itself.
Control lasts 24 hours. Recasting on up to 4 of them before then renews control instead of raising one more.
animate-dead.higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 raises or keeps 2 more undead, each from its own corpse or bone pile.
animate-dead.material: Drop of blood, bit of flesh, pinch of bone dust

description: Touch a closed entryway (door, window, gate, chest and the like) to lock it until dispelled. You and creatures you name when casting open it normally. You can set a password: speaking it within 5 ft suppresses the spell for 1 minute.
Anyone else finds it impassable until it is broken, dispelled or suppressed; knock suppresses it for 10 minutes. The DC to break it or pick its locks rises by 10.
arcane-lock.material: Gold dust worth 25 gp, used up

description: You consult a divining tool and get an omen from an otherworldly power about a specific plan you mean to carry out in the next 30 minutes. The DM gives one answer:
• Weal: good results.
• Woe: bad results.
• Weal and woe: both.
• Nothing: neither especially good nor bad.
It ignores later changes, such as new spells or a companion lost or gained. Each extra casting before your next long rest adds a cumulative 25% chance of a random reading, rolled secretly by the DM.
augury.material: Marked sticks, bones or similar tokens worth 25 gp

description: A 30 ft radius aura of healing surrounds you and moves with you for up to 1 minute (concentration). As a bonus action on each of your turns, you can restore 2d6 hit points to one creature in the aura, including yourself.
You touch a willing creature. For up to 1 hour (concentration) its skin turns rough like bark, and its AC is never lower than 16, whatever armor it wears.

Choose any number of creatures within 30 ft. For up to 1 minute (concentration), each has advantage on Wisdom saves and death saves, and any healing it receives restores the maximum possible hit points instead of rolling.
Touch a willing beast. For up to 1 hour (concentration), spend your action to look and listen through it, using any special senses it has; another action brings you back.
Meanwhile you can't see or hear your own surroundings.
You touch a creature; it makes a Wisdom save or is cursed for up to 1 minute (concentration). Pick the curse when you cast:
• Disadvantage on ability checks and saves with one ability score you choose.
• Disadvantage on its attack rolls against you.
• Each time its turn begins, it makes a Wisdom save; failing wastes its action that turn.
• Your attacks and spells deal it an extra 1d8 necrotic damage.
Remove curse ends it. The DM may allow another curse of similar strength.
bestow-curse.higherLevels: Slot 4: concentration, up to 10 minutes; slot 5: 8 hours; slot 7: 24 hours; slot 9: until dispelled (slot 5 or higher needs no concentration).

description: The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack before the spell ends (concentration, up to 1 minute), your weapon blazes with light: the hit deals an extra 3d8 radiant damage, and the target makes a Constitution save or is blinded until the spell ends.
A blinded target repeats the save after each of its turns, ending the blindness on a success.

Pick 1 creature you can see within 30 ft. It makes a Constitution save; on a failure it is blinded or deafened (you choose) for 1 minute. It repeats the save after each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.
blindness-deafness.higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1 more target.

description: For 1 minute, after each of your turns, roll a d20. On 11 or higher you vanish to the Ethereal Plane (wasted if already there).
You return at the start of your next turn, or when the spell ends while ethereal, to a free space you can see within 10 ft of where you left (or the nearest free one).
While ethereal you see your plane in gray out to 60 ft, and only ethereal creatures can affect you or be affected by you. End it early as an action.

Your outline blurs for up to 1 minute (concentration). Attacks against you are made at disadvantage, unless the attacker doesn't rely on sight (e.g. blindsight) or sees through illusions (e.g. truesight).
The next time you hit with a weapon attack before the spell ends (concentration, up to 1 minute), the hit deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage.
The target becomes visible if it was invisible, sheds dim light in a 5 ft radius, and can't turn invisible until the spell ends.
branding-smite.higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d6 to the extra damage.

description: A 10 ft tall storm cloud with a 60 ft radius forms 100 ft above you (it fails without room). Cast outdoors in a storm, you command that storm instead and damage gains 1d10.
Pick a point you can see within 120 ft: lightning hits it, and each creature within 5 ft makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d10 lightning damage, half on a success.
On later turns, until the spell ends, you can use your action to strike again at the same or a new point.
call-lightning.higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1d10 damage.

description: Each humanoid in a 20 ft radius sphere within 60 ft makes a Charisma save (it may fail on purpose). On each failure, pick one effect, for up to 1 minute (concentration):
Suppress: any charm or fear on it is paused, resuming afterwards if its time hasn't run out.
Indifference: it stops being hostile to creatures you choose, until it is attacked, harmed by a spell, or sees a friend harmed. Afterwards it is hostile again unless the DM rules otherwise.

You place an invisible sensor within 1 mile, in a place you know (visited or seen) or an obvious spot you don't, such as behind a door or around a corner. It stays put for up to 10 minutes (concentration) and can't be attacked or touched.
Choose seeing or hearing; you sense through the sensor as if you stood there. As an action you can switch senses. Creatures that see invisible things notice a fist-sized glowing orb.
clairvoyance.material: Focus worth 100 gp: jeweled horn (hearing) or glass eye (seeing)

description: Spinning daggers fill a 5 ft cube centred on a point within 60 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration). Entering the cube on a turn (first time only) or beginning a turn inside deals 4d4 slashing damage to a creature. No save or attack roll.
cloud-of-daggers.higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 2d4 damage.

description: Fey spirits in beast form appear in free spaces you can see within 60 ft. Pick one group:
• 1 beast of CR 2 or lower
• 2 beasts of CR 1 or lower
• 4 beasts of CR 1/2 or lower
• 8 beasts of CR 1/4 or lower

They count as fey, are friendly, and share one initiative; they obey your spoken orders (no action needed) or else just defend themselves. One reduced to 0 hit points vanishes. The DM has their stats.
conjure-animals.higherLevels: Slot 5 doubles the number of creatures, slot 7 triples it, slot 9 quadruples it.

description: You throw a nonmagical weapon or shoot a piece of nonmagical ammunition, and copies of it spray out in a 60 ft cone. Each creature in the cone makes a Dexterity save, taking 3d8 damage of the weapon's or ammunition's type on a failure, or half on a success.
conjure-barrage.material: 1 piece of ammunition or a thrown weapon

description: An object you touch gives off a flame as bright as a torch until dispelled. It looks like real fire but makes no heat and needs no air. You can cover or hide it, but nothing smothers or douses it.
continual-flame.material: Ruby dust worth 50 gp, used up

description: You push 4 nonmagical arrows or bolts into the ground within 5 ft to guard the area for 8 hours. When you cast, you can name creatures it ignores.

Each time another creature comes within 30 ft of them (first time that turn) or finishes its turn that close, one piece flies at it: Dexterity save or 1d6 piercing damage. That piece is then destroyed; the spell ends when none are left.
cordon-of-arrows.higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 lets you use 2 more pieces of ammunition.

description: You try to stop a spell as it is being cast. If it is 3rd level or lower, it simply fails with no effect.
Higher-level spells (4th or above) need an ability check with your spellcasting ability, DC 10 + the spell's level; succeed and it fails.
counterspell.higherLevels: The spell fails automatically if its level is no higher than the slot you used.

description: You make 30 gallons of water and 45 pounds of food within 30 ft, on the ground or in containers: a day's supply for up to 15 humanoids or 5 steeds. The food is bland but filling and spoils if not eaten within 24 hours; the water stays clean.
A humanoid you can see within 120 ft makes a Wisdom save or is charmed by you for up to 1 minute (concentration).
Each of its turns, before moving, it must spend its action on a melee attack at a creature you mentally pick (not itself). If you pick none, or none is in reach, it acts normally.
On your later turns you must use your action to keep control, or the spell ends. It repeats the save after each of its turns, ending the spell on a success.
A 30 ft radius aura of holy power surrounds you and moves with you for up to 1 minute (concentration). Every nonhostile creature in it, you included, adds 1d4 radiant damage to its weapon hits.

Magical darkness fills a 15 ft radius sphere around a point within 60 ft for up to 10 minutes (concentration). It spreads around corners; darkvision can't see through it and nonmagical light can't light it.
If you pick an object you hold or one nobody is wearing or carrying, the darkness moves with it; covering it with something opaque, like a bowl or helm, blocks the darkness.
Any light from a spell of 2nd level or lower that overlaps it is dispelled.
You touch a willing creature. For 8 hours it can see in the dark, with darkvision out to 60 ft.
darkvision.material: Pinch of dried carrot or an agate

description: For 1 hour, a 60 ft radius sphere of bright light, with dim light for another 60 ft, spreads from a point within 60 ft.
If you pick an object you hold or one nobody is wearing or carrying, the light moves with it; covering it with something opaque, like a bowl or helm, blocks the light.
Any darkness from a spell of 3rd level or lower that overlaps it is dispelled.
As an action (and when casting), read the surface thoughts of one creature you see within 30 ft; Intelligence 3 or lower, or no language: immune.

Probe deeper (action): Wisdom save. Fail: you learn its reasoning, mood and what weighs on it. Success: spell ends. It notices; until you switch, it can use its action on an Intelligence contest to end the spell.

Or, when casting or as an action, sense unseen thinking creatures within 30 ft (2 ft of rock, 2 inches of metal or any lead sheet blocks this; the same immunity applies), then read them while they stay in range.
Target one creature, object or magical effect within 120 ft. Any spell of 3rd level or lower affecting it is ended.
Against each spell of 4th level or above, roll an ability check with your spellcasting ability against DC 10 + its level; a success ends that spell.
dispel-magic.higherLevels: Spells of a level no higher than the slot you used end automatically.

description: A nonmagical weapon you touch turns magic for up to 1 hour (concentration). Pick acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder: the weapon gains +1 on attack rolls, and each hit adds 1d4 damage of that type.
elemental-weapon.higherLevels: Slot 5 or 6: +2 and 2d4; slot 7 or higher: +3 and 3d4.

description: You touch a creature and give it one boon for up to 1 hour (concentration):
Bear's Endurance: advantage on Constitution checks, plus 2d6 temporary hit points that vanish when the spell ends.
Bull's Strength: advantage on Strength checks; carrying capacity doubles.
Cat's Grace: advantage on Dexterity checks; no damage from falls of 20 ft or less unless incapacitated.
Eagle's Splendor, Fox's Cunning, Owl's Wisdom: advantage on Charisma, Intelligence or Wisdom checks.
enhance-ability.higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1 more target.
enhance-ability.material: Fur or a feather from a beast

description: A creature or unattended object you can see within 30 ft grows or shrinks for up to 1 minute (concentration); an unwilling creature resists with a Constitution save. Its worn and carried gear changes too; dropped items return to normal.
Enlarge: twice the size (1 category up, as space allows), 8 times the weight. Advantage on Strength checks and saves; its weapons deal +1d4 damage.
Reduce: half size (1 category down), one-eighth the weight. Disadvantage on Strength checks and saves; its weapons deal 1d4 less damage (minimum 1).

You speak a captivating stream of words. Creatures you choose that you can see within 60 ft and that hear you make a Wisdom save. Creatures immune to charm pass automatically; one your party is fighting has advantage.
On a failure, for 1 minute or until it can't hear you, it has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice anyone but you. Being incapacitated or unable to speak ends the spell.
An illusion of their worst fears hits each creature in a 30 ft cone. Each makes a Wisdom save or drops what it holds and is frightened for up to 1 minute (concentration).

A frightened creature must Dash away from you by the safest route on each of its turns, unless it has nowhere to go. If it ends its turn where it can't see you, it makes a Wisdom save; a success ends the spell on it.
You touch a willing creature and it falls into a deathlike trance for 1 hour, or until you touch it as an action to end it. Inspection and spells that check its status show it as dead.
It is blinded and incapacitated, its speed is 0, and it resists all damage except psychic. Any disease or poison it has or gets does nothing until the spell ends.

A spirit steed appears in a free space within 30 ft: warhorse, pony, camel, elk, mastiff or another the DM allows. Beast stats, but celestial, fey or fiend (you pick); Intelligence 5 or less becomes 6; it understands one language you speak.
It serves as your mount. While you ride it, your self-only spells can also target it. Telepathy within 1 mile.
At 0 hit points, or dismissed as an action, it vanishes; recasting restores it at full hit points. One steed only; an action releases it for good.

You learn whether any trap lies within 120 ft and in your line of sight. A trap here means anything deliberately built to cause a sudden harmful or unwanted effect, for example a glyph of warding, an alarm ward or a pit trap, but not natural hazards like a weak floor or hidden sinkhole.
You learn only that a trap exists and the general kind of danger, not where it is.
A scimitar-sized blade of fire forms in your free hand for up to 10 minutes (concentration). If you let go it vanishes, but you can call it back as a bonus action.
Use your action to swing it as a melee spell attack, dealing 3d6 fire damage on a hit. It sheds bright light for 10 ft and dim light for 10 ft more.
flame-blade.higherLevels: Every 2 slot levels above 2 add 1d6 damage.

description: A 5 ft wide ball of fire appears in a free space within 60 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration). A creature that ends its turn within 5 ft of it makes a Dexterity save: 2d6 fire damage, half on a success.

As a bonus action, roll it up to 30 ft; a creature it rams makes the save and the sphere stops for the turn. It hops 5 ft barriers and 10 ft pits, ignites unattended flammables, and lights 20 ft bright plus 20 ft dim.
flaming-sphere.higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d6 damage.
flaming-sphere.material: Bit of tallow, pinch of brimstone, dusting of powdered iron

description: You touch a willing creature; it gains a flying speed of 60 ft for up to 10 minutes (concentration). When the spell ends, it falls if still in the air, unless it can stop itself.
fly.higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1 more target.

description: A willing creature you touch, with all its gear, becomes a misty cloud for up to 1 hour (concentration). Dropping to 0 hit points ends it; incorporeal creatures are unaffected.

As mist it only flies, at 10 ft, can enter others' spaces and slip through cracks (liquids count as solid surfaces), resists nonmagical damage, has advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution saves, and hovers even if stunned.
It can't speak, attack, cast spells, or handle objects, and can't use or drop what it carries.
gaseous-form.material: Gauze scrap and a wisp of smoke

description: Touch a corpse or other remains: for 10 days it neither decays nor can become undead.
Days under this spell don't count toward the time limit of spells like raise dead, so it buys more time to revive the creature.
gentle-repose.material: Pinch of salt, plus a copper piece on each eye that must stay there

description: You hide a glyph on a surface (up to 10 ft across) or in a closable object; moving the object over 10 ft breaks it, ending the spell. Finding it: Investigation vs your spell save DC.
Set the trigger (touch, opening, approach, reading), optionally by height, weight, creature kind or alignment; exempt creatures, e.g. by password. It ends once triggered.
Explosive Runes: 20 ft radius sphere, spreading around corners; Dexterity save, 5d8 acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder (set when made), half on a success.
Spell Glyph: store a prepared spell (3rd level or lower, one target or an area). It fires at the intruder; summons appear beside it; concentration spells run their full duration.
glyph-of-warding.higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1d8 to explosive runes, and a spell glyph can hold a spell up to the slot's level.
glyph-of-warding.material: Incense and powdered diamond worth 200 gp, used up

description: A 60 ft long, 10 ft wide line of strong wind blows from you for up to 1 minute (concentration). Each creature that starts its turn in it makes a Strength save or is pushed 15 ft away from you along the line.
Moving toward you inside the line costs 2 ft per 1 ft. The wind clears gas and vapor, snuffs candles and torches, and gives shielded flames like lanterns a 50% chance to go out.
Each turn, a bonus action turns the wind to a new direction.

A willing creature you can see within 30 ft is sped up for up to 1 minute (concentration): double speed, +2 AC, advantage on Dexterity saves, and 1 extra action each turn. That action can only be Attack (a single weapon attack), Dash, Disengage, Hide or Use an Object.
When the spell ends, a wave of lethargy hits: the target can't move or act until after its next turn.

A manufactured metal object you can see within 60 ft, such as a metal weapon or medium or heavy metal armor, glows red-hot. Any creature touching it takes 2d8 fire damage on the cast, and again each time you use a bonus action on later turns.

A creature holding or wearing it that takes the damage makes a Constitution save or drops it if able. If it can't or won't let go, it attacks and makes ability checks with disadvantage until your next turn begins.
heat-metal.higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d8 damage.
heat-metal.material: Piece of iron and a flame

description: A 20 ft radius sphere of freezing void opens on a point within 150 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration). No light can brighten it, creatures fully inside are blinded, it is difficult terrain, and its whispers carry 30 ft.
A creature starting its turn inside takes 2d6 cold damage (no save). One ending its turn inside makes a Dexterity save or takes 2d6 acid damage.

A swirl of colors flashes briefly in a 30 ft cube within 120 ft. Each creature in it that sees the pattern makes a Wisdom save or is charmed for up to 1 minute (concentration). While charmed it is incapacitated and its speed is 0.
The effect ends for a creature if it takes any damage or someone uses an action to shake it awake.
hypnotic-pattern.material: Glowing incense stick or crystal vial of phosphorescent material

description: A creature you touch turns invisible for up to 1 hour (concentration), along with whatever it wears or carries while on its person. The spell ends for a target as soon as it attacks or casts a spell.
invisibility.higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1 more target.

description: Pick an object you can see within 60 ft that blocks access: a door, box, chest, manacles, padlock and so on. A mundane lock opens, or a stuck or barred object comes free; with several locks, only one opens.
An arcane lock on it is suppressed for 10 minutes; meanwhile the object opens and closes normally.
Casting it makes a loud knock heard up to 300 ft away.

A 10 ft radius dome of force forms over you and stays put for 8 hours; leaving it ends the spell. It holds you plus up to nine Medium or smaller creatures, and fails if anything larger, or more than nine creatures, is inside.
Those inside at casting pass through freely; everything else is barred, and spells and magical effects can't cross it. Inside stays comfortable and dry.
You can make the inside dim or dark. Opaque from outside (any color), clear from inside.
You touch a creature and end one disease or one condition on it: blinded, deafened, paralyzed or poisoned.

One creature or object you can see within 60 ft, weighing up to 500 pounds, rises up to 20 ft and hangs there for up to 10 minutes (concentration). An unwilling creature that passes a Constitution save is unaffected.

It moves only by pushing or pulling on fixed things in reach, like climbing. Each turn you can raise or lower it up to 20 ft: within your move if it is you, otherwise with your action (it must stay in range). When the spell ends it floats gently down.
levitate.material: Small leather loop, or golden wire bent into a cup on a long shank

description: Your next ranged weapon attack before the spell ends (concentration, up to 1 minute) turns the ammunition, or the thrown weapon, into lightning. Roll the attack normally: 4d8 lightning damage on a hit, half on a miss, instead of the weapon's damage.
Hit or miss, each creature within 10 ft of the target makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d8 lightning damage, half on a success. The ammunition or weapon then returns to normal.
lightning-arrow.higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1d8 to both damage rolls.

description: A 100 ft long, 5 ft wide line of lightning blasts out from you, aimed where you like. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity save, taking 8d6 lightning damage, half on a success. It sets fire to flammable objects nobody is wearing or carrying.
lightning-bolt.higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1d6 damage.
lightning-bolt.material: Fur scrap and an amber, crystal or glass rod

description: Name or describe a specific kind of beast or plant. If any lie within 5 miles, you sense how far away the closest one is and in which direction.
Name or describe an object familiar to you. For up to 10 minutes (concentration) you sense the direction to it if it is within 1,000 ft, and which way it moves if it is moving.

It finds a specific object only if you have seen it up close (within 30 ft) at least once, or else the nearest object of a kind, like a certain sort of weapon or jewelry. Any lead, even a thin sheet, in the direct path blocks it.

A 10 ft radius, 20 ft tall cylinder of glowing runes forms on the ground at a point within 10 ft for 1 hour. Pick one or more types: celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, undead. A creature of a chosen type:
• can't willingly enter by nonmagical means; teleporting or planar travel in needs a Charisma save first;
• has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets inside;
• can't charm, frighten or possess anyone inside.
You can reverse it instead, trapping such creatures inside and shielding those outside.
magic-circle.higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1 hour.
magic-circle.material: Holy water or powdered silver and iron worth 100 gp, used up

description: You set a spoken message of 25 words or less (up to 10 minutes long) in an object you can see within 30 ft that nobody wears or carries, plus a trigger.

The trigger must be something seen or heard within 30 ft, like a creature coming close or a bell ringing. A mouth then appears (on a statue's mouth if any) and speaks in your voice. Choose whether it speaks once or every time.
magic-mouth.material: Honeycomb and jade dust worth 10 gp, used up

description: You touch a nonmagical weapon. For up to 1 hour (concentration) it becomes magic, with +1 to attack and damage rolls.

You make an illusion of an object, creature or other visible thing up to a 20 ft cube, at a spot you can see within 120 ft, for up to 10 minutes (concentration). It has sound, smell and temperature but can't harm or deafen.
While in range, use your action to move it within range and animate it, even making it talk.
Things pass through it. A creature can spend its action on an Investigation check vs your spell save DC; if it succeeds, the image turns faint for it.
major-image.higherLevels: With a slot of 6th level or higher, it lasts until dispelled with no concentration.

description: You call out words of healing: up to 6 creatures you choose and can see within 60 ft each regain 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points. Undead and constructs are unaffected.
mass-healing-word.higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1d4 healing.

description: Spend movement to merge, with your gear, into a stone object or surface big enough to hold you. Nonmagical senses can't detect you.
Inside you can't see out, Perception checks to hear have disadvantage, and you can cast spells on yourself. You can't move, except to step out where you entered (ending it).

If the stone is partly destroyed or reshaped so you no longer fit, you are expelled and take 6d6 bludgeoning damage; total destruction or transmutation deals 50. You land prone in the nearest free space.

Make a ranged spell attack against a target within 90 ft. On a hit it takes 4d4 acid damage now and 2d4 acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss it takes half the first damage and none later.
melfs-acid-arrow.higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d4 to both the first and the later damage.
melfs-acid-arrow.material: Powdered rhubarb leaf and an adder's stomach

description: 3 illusory copies of you appear for 1 minute, moving with you so no one can tell which is real. Dismiss them as an action.

When a creature attacks you, roll a d20: with 3 copies left, 6 or higher makes it target a copy; with 2, 8 or higher; with 1, 11 or higher. A copy has AC 10 + your Dexterity modifier and is destroyed when hit; nothing else harms it. The spell ends with the last one.
Blindsight or truesight ignores them.
A 5 ft radius, 40 ft tall cylinder of pale moonlight (dim light) shines on a point within 120 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration).

A creature entering it for the first time on a turn, or starting its turn there, makes a Constitution save: 2d10 radiant damage, half on a success. Shapechangers save at disadvantage and, on a failure, revert and can't change shape while in the light.
On each later turn you can use your action to move the beam up to 60 ft.
moonbeam.higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d10 damage.
moonbeam.material: Moonseed seeds and a piece of opalescent feldspar

description: For 8 hours, a willing creature, place or object (up to 10 ft in any dimension) that you touch is hidden from divination. Divination magic can't target it, and magical scrying sensors can't see it.
nondetection.material: Diamond dust worth 25 gp, sprinkled on the target and used up

description: Touch a willing creature or an object nobody else holds or wears. For 24 hours it fools divination; pick one or both effects. Repeat it on the target daily for 30 days and it lasts until dispelled.
False Aura: to magic detection, a mundane object seems magical, a magic one mundane, or its aura shows a school you choose. You can let anyone handling it sense the fake magic.
Mask: effects that sense creature type (Divine Sense, a symbol trigger) read it as the type or alignment you choose.

Shadow and hush surround you for up to 1 hour (concentration). You and each creature you choose within 30 ft of you get +10 to Dexterity (Stealth) checks, leave no tracks or other trace, and can't be tracked except by magic.
pass-without-trace.material: Ashes of a burned mistletoe leaf and a spruce sprig

description: A creature you can see within 60 ft makes an Intelligence save. On a failure, only it perceives an illusion you design (object, creature or effect up to a 10 ft cube), with sound and temperature. Undead and constructs are immune.
It believes the phantasm. As an action it can try an Investigation check vs your spell save DC; success ends the spell.
Each of your turns, if it is in or within 5 ft of a phantasm that could plausibly hurt it, it takes 1d6 psychic damage.
A Large, half-real horse with saddle, bit and bridle appears on the ground within 30 ft for 1 hour; you choose its look. Its gear vanishes if taken over 10 ft from it.
You or a creature you pick can ride it. It has riding horse stats, but speed 100 ft and 10 miles an hour (13 at a fast pace).
It ends if the steed takes damage or you dismiss it (action). The steed then fades over 1 minute so the rider can get off.
Two uses:
1 action: normal plants in a 100 ft radius around a point within 150 ft grow thick and tangled. Creatures moving through spend 4 ft of movement per 1 ft. You can leave out any areas you like.
8 hours: plants in a half-mile radius around a point within 150 ft are enriched for 1 year and give double the usual harvest.
Over 10 minutes of prayer, up to 6 creatures you choose and can see within 30 ft each regain 2d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier hit points. Undead and constructs are unaffected.
prayer-of-healing.higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d8 healing.

description: A willing creature you touch gains resistance to one damage type you pick (acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder) for up to 1 hour (concentration).
You touch a creature and cure a poison affecting it; if several afflict it, you end one you know about or a random one.
For 1 hour it also has advantage on saves against being poisoned and resistance to poison damage.
Make a ranged spell attack against a creature within 60 ft. On a hit, for up to 1 minute (concentration), its weapon attacks that use Strength deal only half damage.
After each of its turns, it makes a Constitution save; a success ends the spell.
Your touch ends every curse on one creature or object. A cursed magic item keeps its curse, but its owner's attunement breaks, so the item can be taken off or thrown away.
You touch a creature that died within the last minute; it comes back to life with 1 hit point. It can't revive a creature that died of old age, and doesn't restore lost body parts.
You touch a rope up to 60 ft long. One end rises until the rope hangs straight up, and at the top an invisible entrance leads to an extradimensional space for 1 hour.

Climb the rope to get in. Up to 8 Medium or smaller creatures fit, and the rope can be pulled up out of sight. Attacks and spells can't cross the entrance, but those inside see out through a 3 ft by 5 ft window around the rope.
When the spell ends, everything inside falls out.
rope-trick.material: Powdered corn extract and a twisted loop of parchment

description: You fire 3 rays of fire at targets within 120 ft, all at one target or split among several. Make a separate ranged spell attack for each ray; each hit deals 2d6 fire damage.
scorching-ray.higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1 more ray.

description: For 1 hour, invisible creatures and objects are plainly visible to you. You also see into the Ethereal Plane, where creatures and things appear ghostly and see-through.
see-invisibility.material: Pinch of talc and a little powdered silver

description: Send a message of twenty-five words or fewer to a creature you are familiar with. It hears it in its mind, knows you if it has met you, and can reply the same way right away. Any creature with Intelligence 1 or more understands it.
Distance is no limit, even across planes, but to another plane there is a 5% chance the message fails to arrive.
sending.material: Short piece of fine copper wire

description: A painful burst of ringing sound erupts at a point within 60 ft. Each creature in a 10 ft radius sphere makes a Constitution save, taking 3d8 thunder damage, half on a success. Creatures of stone, crystal, metal or other inorganic material save at disadvantage. Unattended nonmagical objects in the area take the damage too.
shatter.higherLevels: Each slot level above 2 adds 1d8 damage.

description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration), no sound can be made in or pass through a 20 ft radius sphere on a point within 120 ft.
Anything entirely inside is immune to thunder damage, and creatures entirely inside are deafened. Spells with a verbal component can't be cast there.

Freezing sleet fills a 40 ft radius, 20 ft tall cylinder on a point within 150 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration). The area is heavily obscured, open flames go out, and icy ground makes it difficult terrain.

A creature entering it for the first time on a turn, or starting its turn there, makes a Dexterity save or falls prone. Anyone concentrating inside must succeed on a Constitution save vs your spell save DC to keep concentrating.
sleet-storm.material: Dust and a few water drops

description: Up to six creatures you choose in a 40 ft cube within 120 ft each make a Wisdom save or are slowed.

Slowed: half speed, -2 to AC and Dexterity saves, no reactions. On its turn it gets an action or a bonus action, not both, and only one attack. Casting a 1-action spell: roll a d20; on 11 or higher it takes effect next turn using that turn's action, or is lost.
It repeats the save after each of its turns; a success frees it.
A corpse within 10 ft that still has a mouth, isn't undead, and wasn't targeted by this spell in the last 10 days can answer up to five of your questions within 10 minutes.
It knows only what it knew alive, in the languages it knew. Answers are usually short, cryptic or repetitive, and it may lie if hostile to you. It learns nothing new and can't predict the future.
For 10 minutes, plants within 30 ft gain a little awareness: they talk with you, obey simple commands, and can tell you what passed through the area in the last day (creatures, weather and so on).

You can make plant-choked difficult terrain normal, or turn ground with plants into difficult terrain, while the spell lasts. Plants can move branches and tendrils but not uproot. You can talk to plant creatures, and free creatures held by entangle.
For up to 1 hour (concentration), a willing creature you touch can walk up, down and across walls and upside down on ceilings with its hands free, and climbs at its walking speed.
spider-climb.material: Drop of bitumen and a spider

description: The ground in a 20 ft radius around a point within 150 ft sprouts hard spikes and thorns for up to 10 minutes (concentration). It is difficult terrain; every 5 ft a creature moves into or through it deals it 2d4 piercing damage.
The spikes look natural. A creature that couldn't see the area at casting must pass a Perception check vs your spell save DC to notice the danger before entering.
spike-growth.material: 7 sharp thorns or 7 small sharpened twigs

description: Spirits circle you to 15 ft for up to 10 minutes (concentration), angelic or fey if you are good or neutral, fiendish if evil. Choose any creatures you can see to be unaffected.

Affected creatures move at half speed in the area. Each time one enters it (first time that turn) or begins its turn there, it makes a Wisdom save, taking 3d8 radiant damage (necrotic if you are evil), half on a success.
spirit-guardians.higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1d8 damage.

description: A floating spectral weapon appears within 60 ft for 1 minute or until you recast this. As part of casting, attack a creature within 5 ft of it with a melee spell attack: a hit deals 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier force damage.
As a bonus action on your turn, move it up to 20 ft and attack again with it. It looks like whatever weapon you choose.
spiritual-weapon.higherLevels: Every 2 slot levels above 2 add 1d8 damage.

description: A 20 ft radius sphere of yellow, sickening gas fills a point within 90 ft for up to 1 minute (concentration), spreading around corners; the area is heavily obscured.

Each creature fully inside at the start of its turn makes a Constitution save against poison. On a failure it spends its action that turn retching and reeling. Creatures that needn't breathe or are immune to poison pass automatically.
A moderate wind (10 mph or more) clears it in 4 rounds; a strong wind (20 mph or more) in 1.
stinking-cloud.material: Rotten egg or a few skunk cabbage leaves

description: Suggest a reasonable-sounding course of action, in a sentence or two, to a creature you can see within 30 ft that can hear and understand you. Charm-immune creatures are unaffected. Asking for an obviously harmful act ends the spell.
On a failed Wisdom save, it follows the suggestion as best it can for up to 8 hours (concentration), or until the task is done. You can set a trigger; if it never happens, nothing is done.
Damage from you or your companions ends it.
suggestion.material: Snake's tongue plus honeycomb or sweet oil

description: For 1 hour, the creature you touch understands every spoken language it hears, and when it talks, any listener who speaks some language understands it.
tongues.material: Small clay model of a ziggurat

description: Shadows wreathe your hand for up to 1 minute (concentration). Attack a creature in your reach with a melee spell attack: a hit deals 3d6 necrotic damage, and you heal hit points equal to half the necrotic damage dealt.
On each of your turns while the spell lasts, you can use your action to repeat this attack.
vampiric-touch.higherLevels: Each slot level above 3 adds 1d6 damage.

description: You link yourself to a willing creature you touch for 1 hour. While it is within 60 ft of you, it gets +1 to AC and saves and resistance to all damage, but you take the same amount of damage it takes.
It ends if you drop to 0 hit points, you move more than 60 ft apart, either of you is targeted by it again, or you dismiss it as an action.
warding-bond.material: 2 platinum rings worth 50 gp each, worn by you and the target

description: For 24 hours, as many as ten willing creatures you can see within 30 ft can breathe underwater, and still breathe air normally.
water-breathing.material: Short reed or piece of straw

description: For 1 hour, as many as ten willing creatures you can see within 30 ft can walk on any liquid (water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, lava) as if it were harmless solid ground, though lava's heat can still hurt.
A target submerged in liquid rises to the surface at 60 ft per round.

Sticky webs fill a 20 ft cube from a point within 60 ft (difficult terrain, lightly obscured). Unless strung between two solid masses or layered on a surface (5 ft deep), they collapse at the start of your next turn, ending it.
Starting a turn in or entering the webs: Dexterity save or is restrained while there. Escape: action and Strength check vs your spell save DC.
Fire burns a 5 ft cube of web away in a round; creatures starting their turn in that fire take 2d4 fire damage.

A wall of strong wind, up to 50 ft long, 15 ft high and 1 ft thick, rises at a point within 120 ft, in any shape that follows one unbroken path on the ground. Creatures in it when it appears make a Strength save, taking 3d8 bludgeoning damage, half on a success.

It blocks fog, smoke and gases. Small or smaller flyers and objects, and gaseous creatures, can't cross. Ordinary arrows, bolts and other missiles fired through it automatically miss (boulders and siege ammo don't).
wind-wall.material: Tiny fan and an exotic feather

description: For 10 minutes, a 15 ft radius sphere on a point within 60 ft guards against lies. A creature entering it for the first time on a turn, or starting its turn there, makes a Charisma save; on a failure it can't deliberately lie while inside. You know who passed and who failed.
Affected creatures know about the spell, so they can dodge questions or give evasive but truthful answers.
Up to 10 unattended nonmagical objects within 120 ft become your constructs (Medium counts 2, Large 4, Huge 8, max). At 0 HP one reverts, carrying excess damage over.
Bonus action: command any within 500 ft (one order for all); otherwise they only defend. Slam: bludgeoning, 5 ft.
Con 10, Int 3, Wis 3, Cha 1, speed 30 (legless: fly 30, hover), blindsight 30.
Tiny: 20 HP, AC 18, +8, 1d4+4, Str 4, Dex 18.
Small: 25 HP, AC 16, +6, 1d8+2, Str 6, Dex 14.
Medium: 40 HP, AC 13, +5, 2d6+1, Str 10, Dex 12.
Large: 50 HP, AC 10, +6, 2d10+2, Str 14, Dex 10.
Huge: 80 HP, AC 10, +8, 2d12+4, Str 18, Dex 6.
animate-objects.higherLevels: Each slot level above 5 lets you animate 2 more objects.

description: A 10 ft barrier surrounds you and moves with you for up to 1 hour (concentration). Creatures other than undead and constructs can't pass through it or reach across it, though they can still cast spells and make ranged or reach-weapon attacks through it.
The spell ends if your own movement would push one of those creatures through the barrier.
An invisible eye appears within 30 ft and hovers for up to 1 hour (concentration). You see what it sees, in every direction, with normal vision and darkvision to 30 ft.
Action: move the eye up to 30 ft. It can travel any distance from you but not to another plane. Solid barriers stop it, yet it slips through a gap 1 inch wide.

Pick two points on the ground you can see, one within 10 ft of you and one within 500 ft. A ring portal 10 ft across opens over each for up to 10 minutes (concentration). If a creature occupies either point, the spell fails and the slot is lost.
Each ring works from one side only (your choice); whatever enters exits the other ring as if they were adjacent. Mist in the rings blocks sight. Bonus action: turn the rings to face new directions.
For up to 10 minutes (concentration) a 30 ft aura moves with you. Nonhostile creatures in it, you included, resist necrotic damage and their hit point maximum can't be lowered.
A nonhostile living creature that starts its turn in the aura at 0 HP regains 1 HP.

For up to 10 minutes (concentration) a 30 ft aura moves with you. Nonhostile creatures in it, you included, can't be diseased, resist poison damage, and have advantage on saves against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned or stunned.

After 8 hours of work on a gem, you touch a beast or plant, Huge or smaller, with Intelligence 3 or less (or none). It gains Intelligence 10 and speaks one language you know. A plant can also move its limbs and gains human-like senses; the DM picks its stats.
It stays charmed by you for 30 days unless you or your allies harm it. Afterwards it chooses whether to stay friendly, based on how you treated it.
Your next weapon hit before the spell ends (concentration, up to 1 minute) deals an extra 5d10 force damage.

If that hit leaves the target at 50 HP or fewer, it is banished. A creature from another plane is sent home. One native to your plane goes to a harmless demiplane, incapacitated, and returns to its old space (or the nearest free one) when the spell ends.
One creature you can see within 60 ft makes a Charisma save or is banished for up to 1 minute (concentration).
Native to your plane: it waits, incapacitated, in a harmless demiplane, and returns to its space (or the nearest free one) when the spell ends.
From another plane: it is sent home. If the spell ends before 1 minute passes it comes back as above; if it lasts the full minute, it stays gone.
banishment.higherLevels: Each slot level above 4 adds one more target.

description: A Large force hand appears within 120 ft (concentration, 1 minute): AC 20, HP = your HP maximum, Str 26, Dex 10, not space-filling; 0 HP ends it. When cast and as a later bonus action, move it up to 60 ft, then:
Clenched Fist: melee spell attack vs a target within 5 ft of it; 4d8 force.
Forceful Hand: Strength contest vs its Athletics (advantage vs Medium or smaller); push 5 ft + 5 ft × spellcasting modifier.
Grasping Hand: grapple a Huge or smaller target, same advantage. While held, bonus action: crush, 2d6 + spellcasting modifier bludgeoning.
Interposing Hand: half cover for you vs one creature, which can pass only if its Strength tops 26 (as difficult terrain).
bigbys-hand.higherLevels: Each slot level above 5 adds 2d8 to the fist and 2d6 to the crush.
bigbys-hand.material: An eggshell and a snakeskin glove

description: A wall of spinning magical blades appears within 90 ft for up to 10 minutes (concentration): straight, up to 100 ft long, or a ring up to 60 ft across; either way 20 ft high and 5 ft thick. It grants three-quarters cover, and its space is difficult terrain.
A creature that starts its turn in the wall, or enters it for the first time that turn, makes a Dexterity save: 6d10 slashing, half on a success.
One creature you can see within 30 ft makes a Constitution save: 8d8 necrotic, half on a success. Undead and constructs are unaffected.
A plant creature or magical plant saves with disadvantage and takes maximum damage. An ordinary non-creature plant, like a tree or shrub, just withers and dies.
Lightning strikes one target you can see within 150 ft, then 3 bolts leap to up to 3 other targets within 30 ft of it. Targets can be creatures or objects; each takes only one bolt.
Every target makes a Dexterity save: 10d8 lightning, half on a success.
chain-lightning.higherLevels: Each slot level above 6 adds one more leaping bolt.
chain-lightning.material: Fur; amber, glass or a crystal rod; 3 silver pins

description: Negative energy bursts in a 60 ft radius sphere around a point within 150 ft. Every creature in it makes a Constitution save: 8d6 necrotic, half on a success.
circle-of-death.material: Crushed black pearl powder worth 500 gp

description: For up to 10 minutes (concentration) a 30 ft aura moves with you. Friendly creatures in it, you included, have advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects.
When one of them succeeds on such a save that would normally halve the damage, it takes no damage instead.
A 20 ft radius sphere of poison fog centers on a point within 120 ft for up to 10 minutes (concentration). It spreads around corners and is heavily obscured; strong wind ends it.
A creature that starts its turn in it, or enters it for the first time that turn, makes a Constitution save: 5d8 poison, half on a success. Holding breath doesn't help.
As each of your turns begins, the fog rolls 10 ft away from you, sinking into low ground and openings.

You reach your deity or a divine agent and ask up to 3 yes-or-no questions within the minute. Each gets a true answer, though the DM may say "unclear" if it lies outside the deity's knowledge, or give a short phrase if one word would mislead.
Each casting after the first before your next long rest has a cumulative 25% chance of no answer, rolled secretly by the DM.
commune.material: Incense and a vial of holy or unholy water

description: You learn up to 3 facts of your choice about the land within 3 miles of you outdoors, or 300 ft in caves and natural underground. It fails where building has replaced nature, such as towns and dungeons.
Topics: land and bodies of water; dominant flora, fauna, minerals or peoples; mighty celestials, elementals, fey, fiends or undead; the pull of other planes; buildings.
Chosen creatures you can see within 30 ft that can hear you make a Wisdom save (creatures immune to charm pass). Those who fail are affected for up to 1 minute (concentration).

Bonus action each turn: name a horizontal direction. On its next turn each target must use as much movement as it can going that way, though it may act first. It avoids obvious deadly hazards but will provoke opportunity attacks. After moving, it repeats the save to end the effect.
Freezing air blasts from your hands in a 60 ft cone. Each creature there makes a Constitution save: 8d8 cold, half on a success. A creature it kills turns into a frozen statue until it thaws.
cone-of-cold.material: A small crystal or glass cone

description: Each creature in a 10 ft radius sphere around a point within 90 ft makes a Wisdom save or is confused for up to 1 minute (concentration). It can't take reactions and rolls a d10 at the start of each turn:
